app.title: Thousands of Lives
app.tagline: One life in a random country and age — from pharaohs to samurai and Incas. Learn, survive, believe, shape your fate and decide whether your family line goes on.
beta.notice: The texts have not yet been checked by historians — if you find a mistake, tell us in Feedback.

about.title: About the data and sources
about.body1: Thousands of Lives simulates a single human life in the past. We try to make events, occupations, laws and risks fit the era, but the game is a simplification.
about.body2: Mortality follows the Coale-Demeny model life tables ("West", levels 3–5) that historians use for pre-industrial societies. Life expectancy at birth is 24–30 years, mostly because of high child mortality. This is a reconstruction, not exact data.
about.body3: Every historian's note is marked "confirmed by sources", "reconstruction" or "disputed".
about.beta: The beta texts were prepared with the help of AI and have not yet been checked by a historian. If you spot a mistake, let us know.
about.beta_portal: The beta texts were prepared with the help of AI and have not yet been checked by a historian. If you spot a mistake, please tell us in the comments on the game's page.
about.source.1: Coale A., Demeny P. Regional Model Life Tables and Stable Populations. 2nd ed. 1983.
about.source.2: Bagnall R., Frier B. The Demography of Roman Egypt. Cambridge, 1994.
about.source.3: Scheidel W. (ed.) The Cambridge Companion to the Roman Economy. 2012.
about.source.4: Thucydides. History of the Peloponnesian War (on the war and the plague of Athens).
about.source.5: Polybius, Livy, Plutarch, Suetonius on events of Roman history.
about.privacy: Saves are stored only in your browser. Yandex Metrica is used for visit statistics.
about.privacy_portal: Your saves are kept in your browser and, if you are signed in to CrazyGames, in your account. The game collects no statistics of its own.

menu.how.1.title: Birth is a lottery
menu.how.1.text: Three reels decide where, when and who you are born: a samurai's son in Kyoto, a weaver's daughter in Florence or a slave in Baghdad. Faith, social class and family are drawn by lot too.
menu.how.2.title: Time flows by itself
menu.how.2.text: A year lasts a few seconds, early childhood even less; in Settings you can stretch it to a minute. Life flows as a feed: childhood, work, weddings, news from the world. You can speed it up or pause it.
menu.how.3.title: Choices shape fate
menu.how.3.text: Learning, trade, marriage, health, risk — and turning points: pirates, buried treasure, a false accusation. Consequences catch up years later.
menu.how.4.title: The family goes on
menu.how.4.text: After death comes the life summary and a Life pattern of 16 archetypes. Continue as your child or be born again.
menu.no_lives: None yet. A first life takes about 20 minutes.

religion.roman_gods.desc: Jupiter, Juno, Mars and the household lares: sacrifices, omens, festivals by the calendar.
religion.egyptian_gods.desc: Ra, Osiris, Isis, Ptah: temples, priests, belief in the judgement of the dead.
religion.mesopotamian_gods.desc: Marduk, Ishtar, Shamash: ziggurats, liver divination, omens.
religion.slavic_pagan.desc: Perun, Veles, Mokosh, house spirits and wood spirits: offerings, amulets, sanctuaries.
religion.judaism.desc: One God, the Torah, the Sabbath, the synagogue and the community.
religion.christian.desc: Faith in Christ: prayer, fasting, the community and its bishop.
religion.catholic.desc: The Latin Church: the Mass, the Pope, monasteries, pilgrimages to relics.
religion.orthodox.desc: The Eastern Church: liturgy, icons, fasts, monasteries.
religion.tewahedo.desc: The Church of Ethiopia: strict fasts, a tabot ark in every church, monasteries on cliffs.
religion.islam.desc: God and His Prophet: five daily prayers, the Ramadan fast, alms, the hajj to Mecca.
religion.zoroastrian.desc: Ahura Mazda, the sacred fire, the struggle of good and evil.
religion.hindu.desc: Shiva, Vishnu, the Goddess: temples, rites, castes, pilgrimages to holy rivers.
religion.buddhist.desc: The teaching of the Buddha: monasteries, meditation, rebirth and the path to liberation.
religion.jain.desc: Non-violence to all living things, strict fasts, ascetics.
religion.chinese_folk.desc: Confucian duty, veneration of ancestors, Daoist spirits and rites.
religion.shinto.desc: Kami — spirits of mountains, rivers and ancestors; shrines, purification, festivals.
religion.maya_gods.desc: Itzamna, Chaak, Kukulkan: the calendar, bloodletting, the ball game.
religion.aztec_gods.desc: Huitzilopochtli, Tlaloc, Quetzalcoatl: the sun feeds on sacrifice.
religion.andean.desc: Inti the Sun, Pachamama the Earth, huacas, ancestor mummies.
religion.african_traditional.desc: Spirits of ancestors and nature, healers and diviners, offerings and masks.
religion.tengri.desc: Tengri the Sky and Etügen the Earth, spirits of mountains and rivers, ancestor ongons: shamans, ovoo cairns on the passes, offerings of mare's milk.

diary.pet_inherited_named: From your elders you also inherited {name} the {animal} — in the family for {n} {p=n:year|years}.

chapter.best: The main thing of these years:
hint.speed: This is the speed of time: {i:pause} pauses, ×2…×10 go faster, {i:skip} jumps to the next event.
hint.year_len: Do years pass too fast or too slow? You can change how long a year lasts in Settings — up to a minute per year.
hint.focus: Now you decide what each year is about. Pick a focus — it shapes skills, money and events.
hint.hero: The Hero tab shows character, skills, faith and way of life. Take a look.
hint.tab_life: Life: your yard, your goal and the What's happening feed. Below the tabs are pause and year speed; To event skips to the next decision.
hint.tab_life_b: Life: your yard, your goal and the What's happening feed. At the bottom: pause (hold it to pick a speed from ×½ to ×10) and To event, which skips to the next decision. Tap the portrait for details about your hero.

hint.tab_diary: Diary: everything that happened, year by year. Key moments only keeps the main events, which go into your life story. World news and notes have their own buttons.
early.fact: It happened to many: {region} in those years only {n} children in a hundred lived to fifteen.
settings.year.auto.desc: About {n} seconds a year, childhood faster
sound.title: Music
sound.ios_hint: Can't hear the music? Check your phone's silent switch and volume.
settings.music.desc: A calm melody of your country and era
ach.age_60.title: Grey Hair
ach.age_60.hint: Good food, exercise and a physician add 6–8 years to an adult's life.
ach.age_70.title: Elder
ach.age_70.hint: Look after your health: Hero tab → Health and daily life.
ach.age_80.title: Fourscore
ach.age_80.hint: Few managed it: it takes plenty, peace and luck.
ach.long_medieval.title: A Long Age
ach.long_medieval.desc: Live to 85 in the Middle Ages (any country except the Ancient world).
ach.long_medieval.hint: Less risk, more care for your health — and patience.
ach.ancient_80.title: Ancient Elder
ach.ancient_80.desc: Live to 80 in the Ancient world: Rome, Hellas, Egypt, Babylon.
ach.ancient_80.hint: In the Ancient world clean water, the baths and a physician matter most.
ach.defy_era.title: Defying the Age
ach.defy_era.desc: Live 25 years longer than the average adult of your time.
ach.defy_era.hint: The average adult lifespan is shown in the life summary, next to the comparison with the age.
ach.century.title: A Hundred Years
ach.plague_survivor.title: Survived the Plague
ach.plague_survivor.desc: Fall ill during an epidemic — and survive.
ach.plague_survivor.hint: During a plague you can nurse the sick — dangerous, but that's how legends are born.
ach.heir.title: Heir
ach.heir.desc: Carry on the family: live the life of an heir.
ach.heir.hint: After your hero dies, choose an heir.
ach.gen_5.title: Five Generations
ach.gen_5.desc: Five lives of one family in a row.
ach.gen_5.hint: For the line to go on you need children — and they must reach adulthood.
ach.gen_10.title: Ten Generations
ach.gen_10.desc: Ten lives of one family in a row.
ach.gen_10.hint: A whole dynasty: protect your children and choose heirs wisely.
ach.via_grandchild.title: Through a Grandchild
ach.via_grandchild.desc: Carry on the family through a grandchild or great-grandchild when no children are left.
ach.via_grandchild.hint: If your children have died, a grandchild can be the heir.
ach.great_grandchild.title: A Great-Grandchild
ach.great_grandchild.desc: Live to see a great-grandchild born.
ach.great_grandchild.hint: It takes a long life and early marriages in the family.
ach.big_family.title: A Big Family
ach.big_family.hint: The "Family" focus of the year brings more children.
ach.family_century.title: A Century-Long Line
ach.family_century.desc: One family's chronicle spans 100 years from the first birth to the last death.
ach.family_century.hint: Keep the family going through heirs.
ach.family_two_centuries.title: Two Centuries
ach.family_two_centuries.hint: Long lives and late heirs make the chronicle longer.
ach.to_be_continued.title: To Be Continued
ach.to_be_continued.desc: The family reached the end of its country's era.
ach.to_be_continued.hint: Keep the family going for generations until the country's chronicle ends.
ach.rags_to_riches.title: Rags to Riches
ach.rags_to_riches.desc: Be born a slave or peasant and die a landowner or noble.
ach.rags_to_riches.hint: Trade, service, a good marriage — and a little risk.
ach.freedom.title: Freedom
ach.freedom.desc: Be born a slave and win your freedom.
ach.freedom.hint: Save for your ransom, serve faithfully — or run.
ach.born_in_chains.title: Born in Chains
ach.born_in_chains.desc: Be born a slave and die free, wealthy and over 60.
ach.born_in_chains.hint: First freedom, then a trade of your own and a long life.
ach.fall.title: The Fall
ach.fall.desc: Be born a noble and die in debt.
ach.fall.hint: Feasts, dice and bad deals will do the job.
ach.master.title: Master of the Craft
ach.master.desc: Reach the top of your trade or service: your own workshop, ship, rank or office.
ach.master.hint: Stick to one trade for years — that's when promotion comes.
ach.scholar.title: Bookworm
ach.scholar.hint: Study as a child and the "Learning" focus as an adult.
ach.pilgrim.title: Pilgrim
ach.pilgrim.desc: Make a pilgrimage: the hajj, Jerusalem, Ise, Kashi, a shrine of your faith.
ach.pilgrim.hint: When the road to a holy place calls — go.
ach.defiant.title: Defiance
ach.defiant.desc: Refuse the marriage your parents chose — and still have a family.
ach.defiant.hint: In a betrothal event you can refuse to obey.
ach.golden_wedding.title: Golden Wedding
ach.golden_wedding.hint: An early marriage and a long life — for both.
ach.unbroken.title: Unbroken
ach.unbroken.desc: Be widowed, marry again and live to 60.
ach.unbroken.hint: After a loss, life goes on.
ach.pillar.title: Pillar of the Family
ach.pillar.desc: Live to see all your grown children married (at least two).
ach.pillar.hint: A long life and a large family.
ach.traveler.title: Traveler
ach.traveler.desc: Live in three different places in one life.
ach.witness.title: Witness to History
ach.witness.desc: Live through 5 historical events in one life.
ach.witness.hint: The longer the life, the more history outside your window.
ach.worlds_5.title: Five Worlds
ach.worlds_5.desc: Live lives in five different countries.
ach.worlds_5.hint: Start a new life — the lottery will cast you into another country.
ach.worlds_13.title: Thirteen Countries
ach.worlds_13.desc: Live lives in thirteen different countries.
ach.worlds_13.hint: Check the country collection to see which are still missing.
ach.both_fates.title: Both Fates
ach.both_fates.desc: Live a man's life and a woman's life in the same country.
ach.both_fates.hint: You can choose the sex in the life setup.
ach.faithful_friend.title: A Faithful Friend
ach.faithful_friend.desc: A dog lived with the family for 15 years.
ach.faithful_friend.hint: Take in a puppy — and feed it even in a hungry year.
ach.old_tortoise.title: Great-Grandfather's Tortoise
ach.old_tortoise.desc: A pet stays in the family for 40 years and passes to the heir.
ach.old_tortoise.hint: Tortoises and parrots outlive their owners.
ach.iron_health.title: Iron Health
ach.iron_health.desc: Live to 70 without ever falling seriously ill (historical mortality only).
ach.iron_health.hint: Look after yourself and don't gamble with your health.
ach.no_mistakes.title: No Room for Error
ach.no_mistakes.desc: Live to 60 in the first life of a family, unprotected, under historical mortality.
ach.no_mistakes.hint: Turn on historical mortality in the settings.
ach.centurion.title: Centurion
ach.centurion.hint: Serve in the legion — and years of loyalty.
ach.free_gladiator.title: Free Gladiator
ach.free_gladiator.desc: Rome: be a gladiator and live to 40.
ach.pharaoh_scribe.title: Scribe
ach.pharaoh_scribe.desc: Egypt and Babylon: become a scribe.
ach.pharaoh_scribe.hint: Study in childhood opens the way to tablets and papyri.
ach.embalmer.title: Embalmer
ach.embalmer.hint: A trade for those unafraid of death.
ach.hegumen.title: Abbot
ach.hegumen.desc: Byzantium: become the abbot of a monastery.
ach.hegumen.hint: First the tonsure, then years in the cloister.
ach.charioteer.title: Charioteer
ach.charioteer.desc: Byzantium: become a charioteer of the Hippodrome.
ach.charioteer.hint: Strength and risk — the darlings of Constantinople.
ach.jinshi.title: Examination Scholar
ach.porcelain.title: Porcelain Master
ach.porcelain.hint: A craft the whole world knows.
ach.debtera.title: Debtera
ach.debtera.desc: Ethiopia: become a debtera — church singer and scholar.
ach.rock_church.title: Rock-Church Carver
ach.rock_church.desc: Ethiopia: carve churches out of rock.
ach.rock_church.hint: Craft and a lifetime of patience.
ach.yam_courier.title: Yam Courier
ach.yam_courier.desc: Mongols: ride with the khan's letters in the relay service.
ach.mingghan.title: Commander of a Thousand
ach.mingghan.desc: Mongols: rise from a ten to a thousand.
ach.mingghan.hint: Start as a warrior of the tümen.
ach.knight.title: Knight
ach.knight.hint: War, service to a lord and a little luck.
ach.cathedral.title: Cathedral Builder
ach.mahout.title: Mahout
ach.mahout.hint: An elephant remembers its mahout all its life.
ach.court_poet.title: Court Poet
ach.hajji.title: Hajji
ach.hajji.desc: The Islamic world: make the hajj.
ach.hajji.hint: When you've saved for the road — set off for Mecca.
ach.astronomer.title: Astronomer
ach.astronomer.desc: The Islamic world: become an astronomer.
ach.astronomer.hint: Study and literacy open the doors of observatories.
ach.samurai.title: Samurai
ach.samurai.hint: The way of the warrior begins with birth in the right family — or a great deed.
ach.tea_master.title: Tea Master
ach.tea_master.desc: Japan: become a master of the tea ceremony.
ach.ballplayer.title: Ballplayer
ach.ballplayer.desc: Maya: become a player of the sacred ballgame.
ach.ballplayer.hint: Strength and agility — and the favor of the gods.
ach.jade_carver.title: Jade Carver
ach.jade_carver.hint: Jade is worth more than gold.
ach.druzhinnik.title: Druzhinnik
ach.druzhinnik.desc: Rus: serve in a prince's retinue.
ach.druzhinnik.hint: Strength and loyalty to the prince.
ach.bell_caster.title: Bell Caster
ach.griot.title: Griot
ach.griot.desc: Mali: become a griot — keeper of memory.
ach.griot.hint: Words and the memory of families.
ach.gold_of_mali.title: Gold of Mali
ach.gold_of_mali.hint: Hard work — and a chance to get rich.
ach.eagle_warrior.title: Eagle Warrior
ach.eagle_warrior.hint: Only for those who distinguished themselves in battle.
ach.chasqui.title: Chasqui
ach.title: Awards
ach.dream_first.title: Visitor from the Future
ach.dream_first.desc: Make a breakthrough in a dream of the future.
ach.dream_first.hint: Dreams come from your second life, at ages 15–40. Remember your school days.
ach.dream_5.title: A Scholar for All Ages
ach.dream_5.hint: Every country brings a new dream and new numbers.
ach.dream_no_hint.title: No Cheat Sheet
ach.dream_no_hint.desc: A breakthrough in a dream with a debate of sages — without a hint.
ach.dream_no_hint.hint: Don't open the textbook while the sages argue.
ach.dream_known.title: Reinventing the Wheel
ach.dream_known.desc: Solve a dream correctly in a country that already knew the answer.
ach.dream_known.hint: Sometimes you are not the first — solving it still feels good.
ach.secret_dream_boom.title: Should Have Studied
ach.secret_dream_boom.desc: Die because a dream of the future went wrong.
ach.secret_dream_boom.hint: Guess at random in a dream and you will find out.
school.train: Tap a dream you have had to replay it with new numbers, with no effect on any life.
school.title: School curriculum
school.lead: Dreams of the future: the ones solved correctly are filled in. Dreams you haven't had yet show as “???”.
summary.cmp_adult_more: You lived {n} {p=n:year|years} — {d} {p=d:year|years} longer than the average adult of your time.
summary.cmp_adult_less: You lived {n} {p=n:year|years} — {d} {p=d:year|years} less than the average adult of your time.
lifestyle.bonus: Varied food, walks, a physician and the baths add an adult here about {n} {p=n:year|years} of life on average.
diary.era_end: The chronicle of the era "{era}" is coming to an end. Your family has gone through {n} {p=n:generation|generations} — to be continued.
era_end.title: The chronicle of this era has ended
era_end.text: Your family has gone through {n} {p=n:generation|generations}. The heir would live most of their life after the end of the chronicle "{era}". To be continued: when the next era arrives in the game, you'll be able to carry this family on. It is saved in the memorial.
era_end.off_hint: From here on — no historical events, news or primers: only the life of the family.
summary.off_chronicle: This life was lived outside the chronicle — after the end of the country's era, since {year}.
diary.emigrated_trade: You moved: your home is now {place} ({country}). Trading in a foreign land means starting over.
diary.emigrated_refugee: You came to {place} ({country}) as refugees. Everything you had stayed behind.
diary.emigrated_captive: You were sold into bondage: {place} ({country}). Home now exists only in dreams.
diary.emigrated_marriage: You moved to your spouse in {place} ({country}).
diary.emigrated_faith: You stayed to live by the holy places: {place} ({country}).
diary.emigrated_invited: You were invited to work abroad: {place} ({country}).
diary.returned_home: You came home to {place} after {n} {p=n:year|years} abroad.
diary.no_homeland: There's nowhere to return to: what was your country ({country}) is no more.
diary.away_homeland: {who} went back home, to the relatives.
abroad.status: You've been abroad for {n} {p=n:year|years}: living far from home ({homeland}) since {year}.
abroad.naturalized: You come from "{homeland}", but you belong here now: you've lived here {n} {p=n:year|years}.
abroad.planned: You'll decide about going home next year.
ach.stranger_20.title: A Stranger Among Others
ach.stranger_20.hint: Events offer a move: trade, service, an invitation.
ach.naturalized.title: One of Them
ach.naturalized.desc: Settle in abroad so well that you become a resident of the new country.
ach.naturalized.hint: Learn the language, start a local family and don't rush back.
ach.half_world.title: Halfway Across the World
ach.half_world.desc: Move to a distant country — halfway across the world.
ach.half_world.hint: Distant roads aren't always open: for example, from Rus to the Islamic world.
ach.prodigal.title: The Prodigal
ach.prodigal.hint: Leave, live long — and still come back.
ach.three_lands.title: A Family of Three Lands
ach.three_lands.desc: The family has lived in three different countries.
ach.three_lands.hint: Moves and heirs — and your family will see half the world.
country.title: Where will you be born next?
country.lead: Thank you for the feedback! In your next life you choose the country of birth — chance decides the year, region and social class. You can change it at the reels.
country.random.desc: As usual: the lottery picks the country
setup.country.locked: You can choose the country of your next life yourself — for a short review of the game.
feedback.prompt.reward.title: Choose where to be born
feedback.prompt.reward.text: This is a beta, and the game changes with players’ feedback. Tell us in a couple of sentences what you liked and what to fix — and you will choose the country of your next life.
spin.fate: Fate is sealed — life will show the rest.
spin.ad.blocked: Your ad blocker is on, so extra spins for an ad are unavailable.
spin.ad.fail: No ad available right now — try again a bit later.
menu.tagline: One life in a random country and age — from pharaohs to samurai. Will your bloodline go on?
challenge.title: Challenge
challenge.start: Live your next life past {n} — and as a reward you choose how you’re born after that: into a noble family or in a country of your choice.
challenge.retry: You didn’t live past {n} this time. Try again: live your next life past {n} and you’ll choose a noble family or your country of birth.
challenge.ready.title: A reward awaits
challenge.ready: Challenge complete! At the reels, pick a reward for your next life: a noble family or a country of your choice.
challenge.note: Challenge: live this life past {n} — and your next one begins in a noble family or in a country of your choice.
challenge.toast: Challenge complete! Your next life: a noble family or a country of your choice — pick it at the reels.
fate.title: Challenge reward — pick one
fate.country.lead: Challenge reward: you choose the country; chance decides the year, region and social class. It works for one life.
install.title: Add to Home Screen
install.text: Add Thousands of Lives to your phone’s home screen — your next life is one tap away.
install.ios: In Safari tap “Share” (the square with an arrow at the bottom), then “Add to Home Screen”.
install.reward: {i:gift} Reward: your next life begins in the royal family.
install.reward.ios: {i:gift} Reward: open the game from its home-screen icon and your next life begins in the royal family.
royal.toast: Home-screen reward: your next life begins in the royal family!
royal.note: Home-screen reward: this life begins in the royal family. The rest is up to chance.
daily.title: Daily gifts
daily.lead: Come back 7 days in a row — on day 7 you’re born into the royal family.
daily.got: Gift received — it works in your next life.
daily.tomorrow: Tomorrow: {gift}. Don’t skip a day or the streak starts over.
daily.week: A full week of gifts! A new one starts tomorrow.
daily.broken: Your streak was broken — back to day 1. Gifts you already got are still yours.
daily.waiting: Day {n} gift is waiting — claim it
gifts.title: Gifts for this life:
gift.country.desc: in your next life you choose the country
gift.country.lead: Gift “Country of your choice”: you choose the country; chance decides the year, region and social class. It works for one life.
gift.respins.desc: in your next life you can spin the reels 3 more times
gift.health.desc: +20 health from birth — a better chance of a long life
gift.noble.desc: your next life begins in a noble or landowning family
gift.dream.desc: in your next life a dream of the future surely comes, by age 25
gift.chest.desc: your family is three times richer at birth
gift.royal.desc: your next life begins in the royal family
gift.earliest.desc: your next life begins at the very start of the game's history — the Ancient Near East, 1550 BC: the longest road ahead for a dynasty
royal.note.daily: Day 7 gift: this life begins in the royal family. The rest is up to chance.
hook.rise_cls: Born {from} — and rose in the world
hook.longevity: Lived to {n} — longer than {p}% of {g:his|her} peers
hook.dream: Saw the future in a dream: “{title}”
hook.abroad_back: Left for a foreign land — and came back home
hook.top: Ranked above {p}% of the people of {g:his|her} land
hook.alone: Lived a whole life without spouse or children
hook.dream_lost: Saw the future in a dream — but the world did not believe
menu.players: {count} {p=n:player has|players have} entered the game so far
menu.subtitle: One life in a random country and age
spin.head: Who will you be born as?
farewell.title: What was said at the grave
farewell.nobody: Only the neighbors came to see {g:him|her} off. None of {g:his|her} family were left.
remains.title: What remained
remains.home: A house and a good name
people.title: Out of 100 peers
people.legend: Light ones lived shorter lives, dark ones longer ({n} of 100). Red is {name}.
farewell.spouse.warm.1: {g:He|She} held the house together when everything was falling apart. Now I have no one to talk to in the evenings.
farewell.spouse.warm.2: We were together almost all our lives. I thought we'd have as many years again.
farewell.spouse.warm.3: {g:He|She} never went to sleep without making peace with me.
farewell.spouse.warm.4: I still set two bowls on the table.
farewell.spouse.cold.1: We lived together a long time. Not always happily, but together.
farewell.spouse.cold.2: I have forgiven {g:him|her} everything. Almost everything.
farewell.child.warm.1: {g:He|She} taught me {g:his|her} trade, and patience. I don't know how we'll manage without {g:him|her}.
farewell.child.warm.2: {g:He|She} was always the first one up. The house is so quiet without {g:him|her}.
farewell.child.warm.3: When I was sick, {g:he|she} sat by me for three nights.
farewell.child.warm.4: {g:His|Her} hands are in every wall of this house.
farewell.child.cold.1: We argued until the very last day. Now there's no one to argue with.
farewell.child.cold.2: {g:He|She} was hard on me. Maybe it had to be that way.
farewell.grandchild.warm.1: {g:He|She} told us about the old days. I remember every word.
farewell.grandchild.warm.2: {g:He|She} always had a nut or a piece of bread in {g:his|her} pocket for us.
farewell.grandchild.warm.3: {g:Grandfather|Grandmother} used to say: the main thing is not to be afraid. I'll try.
farewell.grandchild.cold.1: I hardly knew {g:him|her}. They say {g:he|she} was strong.
farewell.parent.warm.1: Parents should not have to bury their children.
farewell.parent.warm.2: I rocked {g:him|her} in my arms. Now others carry {g:him|her}.
farewell.parent.cold.1: How many times I told {g:him|her}... {g:He|She} never listened.
farewell.sibling.warm.1: As children we shared one bed and one bowl. Now I'm the only one left.
farewell.sibling.cold.1: We hadn't spoken in years. I thought there would be time.
farewell.sibling.cold.2: We won't fight over the inheritance. We've had enough quarrels.
farewell.friend.warm.1: There's no one like {g:him|her} left around here.
farewell.friend.warm.2: {g:He|She} never once refused me help. Not once.
farewell.friend.cold.1: A good person. Stubborn, but good.
goal.freedom.title: Freedom
goal.freedom.wish: You will not die a slave.
goal.rise.title: Rise in the world
goal.rise.wish: You will live better than we did.
goal.wealth.title: Wealth
goal.wealth.wish: May there always be silver in your house.
goal.wealth.step.3: A big house or a treasury
goal.keep.title: Keep the family name
goal.keep.wish: Carry on our line and keep its honour.
goal.keep.step.3: By forty, the family no lower than before
goal.family.title: A big family
goal.long.title: A long life
goal.master.title: Master of your craft
goal.master.wish: May your hands know their work.
goal.learning.title: Learning
goal.learning.wish: Learn — and people will listen to you.
goal.glory.title: A good name
goal.glory.wish: May your name be known and respected.
goal.faith.title: A righteous life
goal.faith.wish: Live by your faith, and you will be rewarded.
goal.world.title: See the world
goal.world.wish: Do not stay put — see how others live. Moves, pilgrimages, voyages and caravans all count.
goal.world.step.1: Another land or a long journey
goal.world.step.2: A third place or a second journey
goal.love.title: Love for a lifetime
goal.love.wish: Find the one to walk through life with.
goal.lead: Pick one. Its steps stay in sight all your life — and at the end you will know if it came true.
goal.ask.mother: What does your mother wish for you?
goal.ask.father: What does your father wish for you?
goal.ask.change: You have grown up. Keep your parents' wish — or choose your own?
goal.none.desc: No steps, no verdict: life as it comes.
goal.inherit: Finish what {name} began: {n} of 4 steps already done.
daily.tip.later: Yours in {n} {p=n:day|days} if you visit every day.
drum.tip.gift: This is a gift — it already sets this reel.
drum.tip.fate: This is the trial reward — it already sets this reel.
diary.band_up: Your standing has risen: you are now among {band}.
diary.band_down: Your standing has fallen: you are now among {band}. The neighbours greet you differently now.
menu.new_life.confirm: The life of {name} is not over yet. If you start a new one, you cannot come back to this one.
menu.promise: One life in a random country and age. In about 20 minutes: choose, take risks, leave an heir.
howto.title: How it works
howto.time: Time runs by itself, year after year. Pause and speed are on the bar at the bottom.
howto.choices: When something happens, the game stops and asks you. Your choices change your fate.
howto.goal: In your first year you pick a life goal: its steps are shown at the top of the screen.
howto.plain: At the end you will see what the life is remembered for, and can carry on the family as an heir.
howto.marks: In your first year you pick a life goal: the ▲ marks in events lead to it.
event.keys: Keys 1–{n} choose · time stands still while you decide
event.goal_closes: A vow of celibacy will close your goal: {goal}
hint.speed_b: Time runs by itself. Below: {i:pause} pauses, {i:skip} jumps to the next event. For speed ×½…×10 hold the pause button or tap «×1».
tour.speed.title: Time runs by itself
tour.speed.text: This button pauses time and starts it again. Hold it to pick a speed, from ×½ to ×10.
tour.skip.title: Straight to the event
tour.skip.text: Don’t want to wait? Jump to the next event or to the end of the year.
tour.hero.title: All about the hero
tour.hero.text: Tap the portrait: occupation, standing, how long you may live. More in the You tab: health, mind, skills, faith.
tour.tabs.title: Tabs
tour.tabs.text: Life is what happens now. You has every stat and your way of life. Family is family and friends. Diary is everything so far, and world news.
tour.goal.title: Life goal
tour.goal.text: The steps to your goal are shown here. Tap to see them all. At the end of the life you will see if it came true.
tour.menu.title: Menu
tour.menu.text: Sound and music, settings (year length, hard scenes), the memorial and awards. You can replay this tour from here.
dice.opp.unknown: a stranger - hard to say what sort
dice.opp.cautious: cautious: bets carefully, watches your hands
dice.opp.cheat: a cheat: his dice look a little too lucky
dice.pick: What do you stake? The opponent stakes the same.
dice.chase_hint: Win it back? One more game - and the pull grows stronger.
dice.locked: The stronger the pull, the bigger the stakes at this table.
dice.spotted: You noticed: the opponent’s die fell too neatly.
dice.won: A win! The opponent pays the same: +{money}.
dice.caught: You were caught swapping a die!
dice.exposed: You exposed the cheat - the stake is yours.
dice.stake.son: Your son {who}: into service for seven years (≈{money})
dice.stake.daughter: Your daughter {who}: married to the winner (≈{money})
dice.stake.wife: Your wife {who}: back to her kin, perhaps with the little ones (≈{money})
dice.ransom.ask: Lost: {animal}. The winner is waiting - hand it over or pay it off?
dice.ransom.paid: A loss - you paid it off in coin: −{money}.
diary.chronicle_move: {why}. The family has moved: home is now {to}.
chronicle.why.baghdad: Baghdad never recovered from the Mongol sack
chronicle.why.cordoba: The Castilians took Córdoba, and the mosque became a cathedral
chronicle.why.kaifeng: Kaifeng is in Jurchen hands, and the Song court has gone south
chronicle.why.constantinople: Constantinople has fallen - now it is Istanbul, the sultan’s city
chronicle.why.kamakura: The Kamakura shogunate fell, and power moved to Kyoto
chronicle.why.kiev: Kiev never rose again after Batu’s sack
chronicle.why.palenque: Palenque has emptied, the people have left
chronicle.why.copan: Copán has emptied, the people have left
social.title: Official channels
memorial.continue_confirm: The life of {name} is under way. If you continue another family line, you cannot come back to it. Continue?
children.title: Children: upbringing and schooling
children.hint: Until 16 you may choose once a year how to raise a child. Schooling is paid every year; a teenager may abandon the path chosen for them.
diary.edu_done.1: {who} finished learning ({path}) - no shine, but knows the work.
diary.edu_done.2: {who} finished learning ({path}), and the teachers are pleased.
diary.edu_done.3: {who} finished learning ({path}) - the best of the pupils.
diary.edu_refused: {who} would not follow the path chosen for them and dropped out ({path}).
diary.edu_unpaid: No money to pay for {who}'s schooling ({money} a year) - learning stalls this year.
diary.child_formed: {who}: the upbringing shows - a new trait: {trait}.
children.none: No children yet. When they come, you can choose their upbringing and schooling here.
estate.title: Family property
estate.hint: Farms, workshops and shops belong to the family and pass to heirs. Each year they bring income, need upkeep and wear down.
estate.empty: The family owns no business yet.
event.home_once: An offer like this is rare: it comes again only if you rise higher. You can also rebuild your home yourself on the You tab, under Family property.
estate.will.title: Will
estate.will.hint: Who gets what. Without a will the property is divided by local custom. An heir passed over against custom may dispute it.
estate.will.error.custom_forbids: Local custom does not allow passing over the youngest son.
estate.will.error.other: The will does not add up: check the heirs.
diary.asset_improved: Improvement ({what}): repaired and enlarged - more income.
diary.asset_seized: The debt went unpaid - the lender took the pledge ({what}).
diary.will_made: You made your will: who gets what after you.
diary.inherit_assets: By custom the family property passed to you: {n} {p=n:holding|holdings|holdings}.
diary.inherit_assets_will: By the will you received {n} family {p=n:holding|holdings|holdings}.
diary.inherit_passed: Part of the family property went to others: {list}.
diary.inherit_dispute: {who} disputed the will: a lawsuit, bad blood, {money} spent.
business.form.ortogh: ortogh, merchants backed by the khan's court
trade.title: Trade
trade.hint: Prices change every year and from place to place. Buying and selling at once is a loss: a trader lives on the difference between years and places. Stock slowly spoils.
trade.stock: Stock: {n} of {max} measures · family trade profit: {money}
unit.head: head
trade.focus_on: This year's focus is Trade: you're at the market yourself. The trader's margin is narrower, and the selling price swings - you may earn more, or less.
trade.focus_off: Choose the Trade focus for the year to be at the market yourself: you'll buy cheaper and may sell dearer (or cheaper).
diary.trade_moved: You couldn't take everything when you moved: {n} measures of goods were sold off cheaply before the road (+{money}).
land.hint: Plots: choose what to sow - only what was grown in this land. Each year the harvest is sold at the market price; 'Store' puts it in the family stock to sell when prices are higher. Stock spoils, and space is limited.
business.title: Family ventures
business.hint: A partnership: you put in capital, partners theirs. Profit is shared by stakes, losses eat the capital. Below a third of the stake - ruin.
business.attention: A business pays in full only in years when your focus is Trade or Work; in other years the family gets half. Caravans get robbed, ships sink, officials take levies.
diary.trade_spoiled: Part of the stock spoiled or went missing - a loss of about {money}.
diary.business_partner: {who} joined as a partner and put in {money}.
diary.business_quarrel: You fell out with a partner ({who}) - they left with their share: {money}.
diary.business_robbed: Trouble in the business ({what}): robbers plundered the caravan - {money} lost.
diary.business_wreck: Trouble in the business ({what}): the ship went down with its cargo - {money} lost.
diary.business_levy: Officials took a levy from the business ({what}) - {money} gone.
diary.business_partner_gone: Your partner ({who}) is gone - their share ({money}) was paid out.
diary.business_closed: The venture is closed ({what}): your part is {money}.
diary.business_bankrupt: The venture went bust ({what}): {money} left of the stake.
diary.inherit_business: You now run the family ventures ({n}).
chronicle.title: The family of {name}
chronicle.card.name: Family of {name}
chronicle.card.title: {gens} {p=gens:generation|generations|generations}
chronicle.card.ask: What will become of your family?
dynasty.gens3.title: Three generations
dynasty.gens5.title: Five generations
dynasty.gens10.title: Ten generations
dynasty.century.title: A century
dynasty.century.desc: the family has lasted over {n} years
dynasty.two_centuries.title: Two centuries
dynasty.two_centuries.desc: the family has lasted over {n} years
dynasty.wanderers.title: Wanderers
dynasty.wanderers.desc: the family lived in {n} or more countries
dynasty.elders.title: Long-lived
dynasty.learned.title: A learned family
dynasty.learned.desc: {n} children of the family finished schooling
dynasty.heirloom.title: Heirloom
dynasty.merchants.title: Merchant dynasty
dynasty.merchants.desc: the family venture has lasted {n} years
dynasty.peace.title: No feuds
dynasty.rise.title: Rose in the world
dynasty.rise.desc: a descendant rose above the founder's class
dice.accept: Keep quiet and accept the result
diary.expecting: {who} is with child - by next year the household will grow.
diary.expecting_self: You are with child - by next year the household will grow.
diary.child_looks_you: {child} is the spitting image of you.
diary.child_looks_elder: {child} looks just like {g=wsex:grandfather|grandmother} {who} - the family is amazed.
diary.child_looks_neighbor: Somehow {child} looks like the neighbour. The street whispers; at home - silence.
diary.travel_trip: You travelled to {place}: new streets, strange accents, different market prices.
promo.title: Special key
promo.hint: We give keys to our followers. The gift goes to your next life; each key works once.
promo.ok: Key accepted: the gift is waiting at the reels.
promo.error.unknown: No such key. Check the letters and digits.
promo.error.used: This key has already been used.
diary.career_changed: You changed your life's work: from {from} to {prof}. The first years will be lean, but the road ahead is open.
career.title: Life's work
career.novice: New at the trade: income is {n}% of usual for now.
career.hint: You can change your work once in five years. The first year brings half the income, then more; income grows with skill.
career.wait: You can change your work from {year}.
hero.paused: Time stands still while you're here: the year's events will wait.
business.grow.shipping: Three shipping ventures have sailed under the family name for over twenty years - time to join them into your own merchant fleet.
business.grow.trading_house: Three trading houses of the family have stood for twenty years - you can join them into your own market with trading rows.
business.grow.artel: Three workshops have worked for the family for twenty years - you can join them into a manufactory.
business.grow.caravan: Three caravans have travelled one road for twenty years - you can build your own inns along it and hold the trade route.
business.units.shipping: Your own fleet: {n} ships. Higher income: your own vessels, your own voyages.
business.expand.artel_slave: Put a slave to work in the manufactory
business.expand.slave_desc: free: more hands, but the slave leaves the household
diary.business_grown.shipping: The family's ships are now one fleet: own vessels, own voyages, a name in every harbour.
diary.business_grown.trading_house: The family's trading houses became its own market: rows, shops, its own scales.
diary.business_grown.artel: The workshops are joined into a manufactory: one roof, many hands.
diary.business_grown.caravan: The family's caravans hold their own trade route - with inns at the stops.
diary.business_expanded.shipping: A new ship was launched - the fleet has {n} now. −{money}.
diary.business_expanded.caravan: A new inn on the road - {n} now. −{money}.
diary.business_expanded.artel_slave: A slave was put to work in the manufactory: more hands - {n} workshops now.
hold.inn.desc: {money}: more income, but dearer to keep
diary.asset_inn: The rental house was rebuilt as an inn: travellers sleep here now. −{money}.
loan.title: Loan
loan.credit_long: The family's credit: {n} of 100. Repay on time and next time they'll lend more and cheaper.
loan.now: You owe {money} at {n}% a year ({interest} each year); repay it all by {year}.
loan.offer: {money} at {n}% a year: {interest} each year, repay it all in {years} years.
loan.hint: Miss the deadline and the debt falls on you, and the family's credit suffers.
loan.lock.riba: Usury (riba) is forbidden here: no one lends at interest. Money is raised through partnership or against a pledge.
loan.lock.debt: No new loans in the debt pit.
diary.loan_taken: Took a loan: +{money} at {n}% a year, due by {year}.
diary.loan_repaid: Loan repaid: −{money}. The lender is pleased - the family will be trusted.
diary.loan_default: The loan wasn't repaid on time: the debt of −{money} fell on you, and the family's credit is ruined.
kin.hint: Tap a person: details and what you can do for them. The bar under the portrait is warmth or coldness between you: warm kin help in hard times, cold kin quarrel and dispute the inheritance.
kin.lock.year: You've already done what you could for this person this year.
kin.act.attention.desc: a kind word, help around the house - free
kin.act.date.desc: a walk, a feast, a treat
kin.act.distance.desc: see each other less - less bother
kin.tutor.desc: {money} a year: learns faster, the family supports
kin.train.sport.desc: {money} a year; after {n} years - a strong body
kin.train.military.desc: {money} a year; after {n} years - skilled with weapons
kin.oversee.desc: half as likely to quit, learns a bit faster - but the child grows distant
kin.own.desc: you teach at home, for free - a little slower than with a master
diary.kin.attention: You found a kind word for {who} - and felt the warmth come back.
diary.kin.date: An evening with {who}: a walk, a treat, talk until dark. −{money}.
diary.kin.cold: You keep {who} at arm's length. Less fuss - and less warmth.
diary.kin.visit: You visited {who}: you sat and talked.
diary.kin.quarrel: A quarrel with {who}: old grudges, loud words.
diary.kin.quarrel_spouse: A row at home: {who} won't forgive your coldness.
diary.kin.tutor_paid: The tutor for {who}, for the year: −{money}.
diary.kin.tutor_gone: No money to pay the tutor for {who} - the tutor left.
diary.kin.train_paid.military: Arms training for {who}, for the year: −{money}.
diary.kin.trained.sport: {who} has grown strong: the years of exercise paid off.
diary.kin.trained.military: {who} can handle weapons: the arms training is done.
diary.kin.teach_own: You began teaching {who} your own trade: {path}.
hold.usual: In an ordinary year without disasters: {money}
hold.buy_none: Nothing to buy right now: your class or region doesn't allow it, or you already own all you can.
hold.empty_estate: The family has no holdings yet. A holding brings income every year, but it wears down, pays tax and can be struck by disaster.
hold.manage: The family runs {n} holdings itself; {m} more go through a steward: they bring less, and he may steal.
hold.land_hint: Income depends on the harvest. New plots and workers are offered for sale through events when there's money in the chest.
hold.steward: Run by a steward: a third less income, and he may steal.
hold.idle: No income this year after the disaster.
hold.worn: Falling apart: income is noticeably lower. Repair it before it's too late.
notice.empty: News of your family and awards will appear here.
notice.hide: Hide the news line (bring it back in Settings)
settings.notices.desc: Family news, goal steps and awards appear in a line under your hero, not as pop-ups.
settings.tour: Tell me more about the game
settings.tour.desc: The tutorial from the start and tips on each tab: what is where and what it does.
howto.focus: Focus of the year is what the hero spends the year on: work brings money and skill, study brings letters and wit, family warms relations, rest and faith ease stress, travel broadens the mind. You can change it any year.
howto.attrs: Health, strength, wit, diligence and charm grow with choices and focus and decide how risky moves end: the chance on a button depends on them.
howto.feelings: Wellbeing - happiness, anxiety, loneliness, self-respect - is shown in words above. Losses leave grief for years; family nearby helps it pass sooner.
howto.money: Money: your trade's income minus the costs of your class and way of life. Debt grows 8% a year - in debt livestock, house and holdings get sold. Family property and ventures earn on top of work.
howto.family: The family: children grow, study and marry; after the hero's death an heir carries on - with money, house and property by local custom or by will.
diary.match_offer_love: {who} loves {suitor}, {from}. They ask your blessing: not an equal match, but one of the heart.
diary.match_offer_equal: A match is proposed for {who}: {suitor}, {from}. An equal - the parents are already reckoning the dowry.
diary.match_offer_rich: A fine match for {who}: {suitor}, {from}. The family would rise, but the dowry asked is no small sum.
diary.match_wed_love: {who} married for love - {suitor}. The neighbours frown, but the house is bright.
diary.match_wed_equal: A wedding: {who} and {suitor}. All as it should be - the agreement, the dowry, the feast.
diary.match_wed_rich: {who} married up: {suitor}. The dowry was hard to raise, but the family is now respected.
diary.match_auto_love: While you hesitated, {who} married as they wished - {suitor}.
diary.match_auto_equal: The match went ahead without your word: {who} and {suitor} are wed.
diary.match_auto_rich: The fine match was settled without you: {who} and {suitor} are wed.
diary.match_refused_love: You refused: {suitor} is no match. {who} says nothing and looks away.
diary.match_refused_equal: The matchmakers were turned away. {who} shrugs: there will be others.
diary.match_refused_rich: You turned down the fine match. The neighbours call you proud, or odd.
diary.match_eloped: {who} left home to be with {suitor} - without your blessing.
children.match.hint.rich: The family will rise in people's eyes.
children.match.wait: If you don't decide within a year, they will.
arms.name: Family name
arms.hint_contrast: The charge blends into the field. The old rule: metal (gold, silver) on colour, colour on metal.
house.pick_hint: The family has lived two lives - time to give it a name and arms. Build the shield: shape, colours, charge. Chosen once: the name and arms stay in the chronicle, the memorial and on the family card.
fgoal.pick_hint: Not for one life but for several generations, picked from what the last hero left. Fulfil it - a Chest gift for the next life.
fgoal.wealth.desc: someone in the family leaves {n} or more
fgoal.heirloom.desc: one family holding passes through {n} generations
fgoal.learned.desc: {n} children of the family finish schooling
fgoal.done: Family goal fulfilled: {goal}! A chest awaits the next life.
heirs.not_custom: By custom {who} inherits: choosing another will hurt them, and where custom is strict, people will talk.
diary.heir_not_custom: You became heir instead of {who}, who now bears a grudge.
diary.heir_not_custom_strict: You became heir against custom, instead of {who}. They are hurt, and the neighbours gossip.
account.title: Account
account.text: Sign in with your email - your lives, memorial and awards are saved on the server and come back on any device.
account.prompt.title: Save your first life
account.prompt.text: Your memorial and awards live only in this browser: clear the history or switch devices and they are gone. Sign in by email to keep them for good. No password - you get a link.
account.newsletter: Send me game news and bonus codes (a couple of emails a month at most)
account.notice: We use your email to sign you in and, if you agree above, to send news and bonus codes. You can unsubscribe and delete your data in Settings at any time.
account.sent: Email sent to {email}. Open the link in it in this browser (valid for 30 minutes).
account.signed: Signed in as {email}. Lives and awards are saved on the server.
account.delete_confirm: Yes, delete for good: email, server saves and my statistics
account.deleted: Done: your data is deleted from the server. Saves in this browser remain.
account.login_ok: Signed in: lives and awards are saved on the server.
account.login_failed: The sign-in link has expired or was already used. Ask for a new one: menu → Sign in.
account.error.region: Sign-in is not available in your region.
account.error.other: That didn't work - please try again a little later.
account.privacy.title: Privacy policy
account.privacy.what: What we keep. If you sign in: your email, your newsletter consent (yes or no, and when), your game saves (memorial and awards). For all players: anonymous gameplay statistics (a random player number, actions in the game, language, device). We do not store IP addresses.
account.privacy.why: Why. Email - to sign you in and restore saves on another device; with your consent - for emails with news and bonus codes. Statistics - to make the game better. We do not sell your data or share it for advertising.
account.privacy.who: Who processes it. The site and database run on Cloudflare; emails are sent by Resend.
account.privacy.keep: How long. Until you delete the data yourself. A sign-in link lives 30 minutes and works once.
account.privacy.delete: Your rights. Unsubscribe and delete your email, server saves and your statistics in Settings with 'Delete my data'. Questions - via Feedback in the menu.
life.grief_tip: Grief for someone close has not eased yet: joy fades and worry builds.
life.grief_left: In mourning for about {n} more {p=n:year|years}: grief takes away joy and adds worry. Family nearby helps it pass sooner.
diary.npc_ill: {role} {who} has fallen gravely ill: {ill}. No one knows how it will end.
diary.npc_recovered: The illness has passed: {role} {who} is back on their feet.
diary.npc_healed: You nursed {g=sex:him|her} back to health: {role} {who} has recovered. The neighbours are talking about your skill.
diary.self_healed: You treated yourself and recovered: a healer’s knowledge came in handy.
crisis.title: The Turn
crisis.stake_hint: This is what the tactic changes most: luck adds more to them, and misfortune hits them at full force.
crisis.stake_ready: Both are 60 or higher - you're ready for this: the tactic's dangers (▼) come up less often.
crisis.stake_grow: Raise both to 60 and the tactic's dangers (▼) will come up less often.
crisis.hint.start_over: New love, new trade, new road. Brighter — and riskier for the family.
crisis.hint.seek_freedom: Buy your freedom, run, find a patron. Freedom is precious — and dangerous.
crisis.hint.hold_on: Work, household, the usual ways. Calmer — but you may break your back.
crisis.hint.seek_meaning: Faith, books, a teacher, a pilgrimage. You may find yourself — or emptiness.
crisis.no_undo: The blow can't be undone — only softened.
crisis.gamble.warn: Luck can be doubled — or lost. There is no third ball.
crisis.family.cost.low: may cool your bond a little
crisis.home.cost: A third of your money will go (with no money, your home gets humbler).
crisis.text.windfall: A distant relative's inheritance, a lucky deal, a lord's reward — fortune came to the house unasked.
crisis.text.windfall.freedom: Someone is ready to help with your ransom. There is money now — and with it, hope.
crisis.text.burnout: Years of work without rest have wrung you dry: the hands work, the strength is gone.
crisis.text.new_passion: A heart you thought cold suddenly caught fire. People are already whispering.
crisis.text.new_passion.poly: You are thinking of a second wife. The house noticed at once.
crisis.text.worn_body: Your back seized so badly you can't get up. Old wounds remind you of the years.
crisis.text.quiet_acceptance: You made peace with what is: your corner, your people, your road.
crisis.text.cold_house: Silence at the hearth. The grown children look at you with strangers' eyes.
crisis.text.new_calling: You took up a new trade. Losses at first — but your eyes are alight.
crisis.text.lost_meaning: What is it all for? The gods are silent, work falls from your hands.
crisis.text.second_wind: As if someone gave you back ten years: strength is there, and work goes well.
crisis.result.family.strong: {name} lent a shoulder. The blow is lighter.
crisis.result.family.conflict: Instead of help — a quarrel with {name}.
crisis.result.home.fail: The money is gone, and nothing is easier.
ach.crisis_survived.title: The Turn
ach.crisis_survived.desc: Live through the turn of forty.
ach.crisis_survived.hint: It comes once a life, between 36 and 44.
ach.crisis_second_wind.title: Second Wind
ach.crisis_second_wind.hint: Strong stakes fear their own dangers less.
ach.crisis_shoulder.title: A Shoulder
ach.crisis_shoulder.desc: Lean on a loved one in the turn — and they hold.
ach.crisis_shoulder.hint: The stronger the bond, the surer the support.
ach.crisis_double.title: Doubled
ach.crisis_double.desc: Risk again after luck — and double it.
ach.crisis_double.hint: The second ball is for gamblers.
ach.crisis_bust.title: Lost It All
ach.crisis_all_stances.title: Three Roads
ach.crisis_all_stances.desc: Go through the turn with all three paths in different lives.
ach.crisis_all_stances.hint: Start over, hold on, seek meaning.
account.no_mail: No email? Check Spam and Promotions — or send it again.
